020
021public class SurveyDataSpecial extends BaseSalvageSpecial {
022
023        public static float MAX_RANGE = 30000f;
024        
025        public static enum SurveyDataSpecialType {
026                SCRAMBLED, // used when the planet is already surveyed or doesn't exist anymore or nothing is found etc
027                PLANET_SURVEY_DATA,
028                
029                // these are not really interesting enough
030                @Deprecated PLANET_INTERESTING_PROPERTY,
031                @Deprecated SYSTEM_PRELIMINARY_SURVEY,
032                @Deprecated AUTO_PICK, // generate one of the above automatically, for a nearby planet or system
033                @Deprecated AUTO_PICK_NOT_SYSTEM, // pick either property or data, but not full system
034        }
035        
036        
037        public static class SurveyDataSpecialData implements SalvageSpecialData {
038                public SurveyDataSpecialType type = null;
039                public String entityId = null;
040                
041                @Deprecated public String secondaryId = null;
042                
043                public boolean includeRuins = true;
044                public SurveyDataSpecialData(SurveyDataSpecialType type) {
045                        this.type = type;
046                }
047                
048                public SalvageSpecialPlugin createSpecialPlugin() {
049                        return new SurveyDataSpecial();
050                }
051        }
052        
053        private SurveyDataSpecialData data;
054        
055        public SurveyDataSpecial() {
056        }
057
058        @Override
059        public void init(InteractionDialogAPI dialog, Object specialData) {
060                super.init(dialog, specialData);
061                
062                data = (SurveyDataSpecialData) specialData;
063                
064                //random = new Random();
065                
066                if (data.type == SurveyDataSpecialType.PLANET_SURVEY_DATA && data.entityId == null) {
067                        List<StarSystemAPI> systems = Misc.getSystemsInRange(entity, null, true, MAX_RANGE);
068                        PlanetAPI planet = DerelictThemeGenerator.findInterestingPlanet(systems, null, false, data.includeRuins, random);
069                        if (planet != null) {
070                                data.entityId = planet.getId();
071                        }
072                }
073                
074                if (data.entityId != null) {
075                        SectorEntityToken entity = Global.getSector().getEntityById(data.entityId);
076                        StarSystemAPI system = Global.getSector().getStarSystem(data.entityId);
077                        if (entity == null && system == null) { 
078                                data.entityId = null;
079                                data.type = SurveyDataSpecialType.SCRAMBLED;
080                        }
081                } else {
082                        data.type = SurveyDataSpecialType.SCRAMBLED;
083                }
084                
085                
086                switch (data.type) {
087                case SCRAMBLED:
088                        initNothing();
089                        break;
090                case PLANET_SURVEY_DATA:
091                        initPlanetSurveyData();
092                        break;
093                default:
094                        initNothing();
095                        break;                  
096                }
097
098        }
099
100        public void initNothing() {
101                boolean debris = entity != null && Entities.DEBRIS_FIELD_SHARED.equals(entity.getCustomEntityType());
102                if (debris) {
103                        addText("An array of memory banks is found in the debris field, but it's been scrubbed clean by hard radiation, and no data can be retrieved.");
104                } else {
105                        addText("The $shortName's memory banks have been scrubbed clean by hard radiation, and the systems are largely inert and non-functional.");
106                }
107                setDone(true);
108        }
109        
110
111        protected void initPlanetSurveyData() {
112                if (data.entityId == null) {
113                        initNothing();
114                        return;
115                }
116                
117                PlanetAPI planet = (PlanetAPI) Global.getSector().getEntityById(data.entityId);
118                if (planet.getMarket() != null && planet.getMarket().getSurveyLevel() == SurveyLevel.FULL) {
119                        initNothing();
120                        return;
121                }
122                
123
124                String name = planet.getName();
125                String world = planet.getSpec().getAOrAn() + " " + planet.getTypeNameWithWorld().toLowerCase();
126                //String loc = getLocationName(planet);
127                String loc = BreadcrumbSpecial.getLocatedString(planet, true);
128                loc = loc.replaceFirst("located ", "");
129                
130                String text1 = "The $shortName's memory banks are partially accessible, " +
131                                           "and contain full survey data for " + name + ", " + world + " located " + loc + ".";
132                boolean debris = entity != null && Entities.DEBRIS_FIELD_SHARED.equals(entity.getCustomEntityType());
133                if (debris) {
134                        text1 = "An array of memory banks found in the debris field is partially accessible, " +
135                                           "and contains full survey data for " + name + ", " + world + " located " + loc + ".";
136                }
137                
138                String text1ForIntel = "While exploring $aOrAn $nameInText, your crews found " +
139                                                           "partially accessible memory banks that contain full survey data for " +
140                                                           name + ", " + world + " located " + loc + ".";
141                
142                //boolean debris = Entities.DEBRIS_FIELD_SHARED.equals(entity.getCustomEntityType());
143                if (debris) {
144                        text1 = "Your salvage crews find a functional memory bank in the debris. " +
145                                        "It contains full survey data for " + name + ", " + world + " located " + loc + ".";
146                }
147                
148                String conditionId = DerelictThemeGenerator.getInterestingCondition(planet, data.includeRuins);
149                if (conditionId != null) {
150                        MarketConditionSpecAPI spec = Global.getSettings().getMarketConditionSpec(conditionId);
151                        if (spec != null) {
152                                text1 += " The world is notable for ";
153                                text1ForIntel += " The world is notable for ";
154                                if (conditionId.equals(Conditions.HABITABLE)) {
155                                        text1 += "being habitable.";
156                                        text1ForIntel += "being habitable.";
157                                } else {
158                                        text1 += "having " + spec.getName().toLowerCase() + ".";
159                                        text1ForIntel += "having " + spec.getName().toLowerCase() + ".";
160                                }
161                        }
162                }
163                
164                
165                //planet.getMarket().setSurveyLevel(SurveyLevel.PRELIMINARY);
166                
167                //String subject = "Survey Data: " + name + ", " + planet.getTypeNameWithWorld();
168                
169                addText(text1);
170                Misc.setFullySurveyed(planet.getMarket(), null, false);
171                Misc.addSurveyDataFor(planet, text);
172//              text.setFontSmallInsignia();
173//              text.addParagraph("Acquired full survey data for " + name + ", " + planet.getTypeNameWithWorld().toLowerCase(),
174//                                                              planet.getSpec().getIconColor());
175//              text.setFontInsignia();
176                
177                SurveyPlugin plugin = (SurveyPlugin) Global.getSettings().getNewPluginInstance("surveyPlugin");
178                plugin.init(Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet(), planet);
179                long xp = plugin.getXP();
180                if (xp > 0) {
181                        Global.getSector().getPlayerPerson().getStats().addXP(xp, text);
182                }
183                
184                new SurveyDataForPlanetIntel(planet, getString(text1ForIntel), text);
185
186//              BreadcrumbIntel intel = new BreadcrumbIntel(entity, planet);
187//              intel.setTitle(getString(subject));
188//              intel.setText(getString(text1ForIntel));
189//              intel.setShowSpecificEntity(true);
190//              //intel.setIcon(Global.getSettings().getSpriteName("intel", "found_planet_data"));
191//              intel.setIconId("found_planet_data");
192//              Global.getSector().getIntelManager().addIntel(intel, false, text);
193                
194//              CommMessageAPI message = FleetLog.beginEntry(subject, planet);
195//              message.getSection1().addPara(getString(text1));
196//              FleetLog.addToLog(message, text);
197                
198                //unsetData();
199                setDone(true);
200        }

205                super.optionSelected(optionText, optionData);
206        }
